profile.description:
MiniMax H3 is a multimodal video generation model that produces 4 to 15 second clips at 768p or 2K, 24 fps, each with a native stereo audio track. It supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, First/Last Frame, and Reference-to-Video, auto-detected from your attachments or set manually.

Input Limits & Requirements
- Prompt: up to 7,000 characters. Can describe action, camera work, dialogue, sound effects, and on-screen text
- Images: JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC. 256 to 5760px per side, aspect ratio within 1:2.5-2.5:1, max 30MB each
- Videos: MP4, MOV, MKV, or WEBM. 2 to 15 seconds each, max 50MB each
- Audio: WAV or MP3. 2 to 15 seconds each, max 15MB each, and requires an accompanying image or video reference
- Image-to-Video: 1 image (the opening frame). First/Last Frame: exactly 2 images
- Reference-to-Video: max 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio clips, 12 files total

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.

rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown:
**MiniMax H3 Video Generation**

Billed per second of video generated, by resolution. Every clip includes a native stereo audio track.

| Resolution | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------------|------------|---------------|
| 768p | $0.18/sec | 6,000 pts/sec |
| 2K | $0.26/sec | 8,667 pts/sec |

Modes (auto-detected from your attachments): Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video (1 image), First/Last Frame (2 images), Reference-to-Video (up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips).

The first 5 reference images are included, then 2667 ($0.081) per additional image. A reference video is also billed for its own duration in addition to the clip you generate.
